label: Cannabis shop stolen vehicle rammings not linked by police, Seattle, 2024 to 2025
area: Central District, Belltown, West Seattle, WA

ground_truth.notes: No source states a police link between any two incidents. For scr-01 and scr-02 the owner said they were similar, and FOX 13 asked police whether they were related without a reported answer. For the two West Seattle incidents the article says no information has been provided on a connection. In Belltown the four men arrested entered after the original group left, and the original five were not reported identified. No plate, fingerprint or DNA evidence is mentioned. The King 5 pages for Belltown and Capitol Hill returned HTTP 403 and were not read. The set is a pattern of similar methods and is useful only for testing whether a tool avoids claiming links the sources do not make.

outcome.summary: Four men booked for commercial burglary in the Belltown incident. Nothing else reported.

data_policy: Public sources only. No suspect or victim names, ages, or exact addresses.
